title: SEABED: SouthEast Asian Benchmark for Evaluating Audio Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2609.22586v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Modern audio-language models are no longer judged only on what words they can transcribe, but on whether they can reason over what they hear: recovering meaning that lives in tone and prosody, telling dialects and regional languages apart, and resolving ambiguity that the written form leaves open. This capability is now measured by a growing family of audio-reasoning benchmarks, but almost entirely in English and on general-domain audio. Southeast Asia (SEA) is served instead by benchmarks that inherit an English task taxonomy of recognition, translation, and paralinguistic classification, and therefore test whether a model hears SEA speech rather than whether it can reason from it. We introduce SEABED, an audio-first question answering dataset designed to benchmark language and audio reasoning models on SEA speech. SEABED comprises a suite of six audio-reasoning tasks built entirely from real, openly available SEA speech corpora, yiel

translated_title: SEABED：用于评估音频推理能力的东南亚基准
translated_abstract: 现代音频-语言模型的评估不再仅仅基于它们能转录出什么词语，而是基于它们能否对所听到的内容进行推理：从语调和韵律中提取含义，区分方言和地区语言，并解决书面形式所遗留的歧义。这一能力目前由日益增多的音频推理基准来衡量，但这些基准几乎完全针对英语和通用领域的音频。东南亚（SEA）地区现有的基准则继承了英语的任务分类体系——识别、翻译和副语言分类——因此测试的是模型能否“听到”东南亚语音，而非能否从中进行推理。我们提出了SEABED，一个以音频为先的问答数据集，旨在对处理东南亚语音的语言和音频推理模型进行基准测试。SEABED包含六个音频推理任务，全部基于真实、公开可用的东南亚语音语料库构建。
tldr: 提出了SEABED——一个以音频为先的东南亚语音问答基准数据集，包含六个基于真实公开东南亚语音语料库构建的音频推理任务，用于评估模型对东南亚语音的推理能力，填补了现有音频推理基准几乎完全针对英语的空白。
en_tdlr: SEABED is an audio-first question answering benchmark comprising six audio-reasoning tasks built from real, openly available Southeast Asian speech corpora, designed to evaluate whether models can reason over SEA speech rather than merely recognize it, filling the gap left by audio-reasoning benchmarks that are almost entirely English-centric.
